title: Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders Delivery Promise and Carrier Return Rules
content:
These clauses govern the delivery promise on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders and what follows when the carrier cannot deliver.

**Clause 1 - The promise.** Delivery is promised the method's promised business days after the order date; orders placed after the method's order cutoff time count from the next day.

**Clause 2 - Fee refund for a missed promise (retired).** Formerly: where the method refunds the fulfillment fee on late delivery and the order is completed after its promised date, or, for Same-Day Delivery, more than the method's grace minutes after the end of the promised delivery window, the fulfillment fee is refunded. This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for late-delivery fee refunds.

**Clause 3 - Delays that are never late.** A delay caused by the customer's absence or a changed address is never late.

**Clause 4 - Return to sender.** After the method's included number of failed delivery attempts, the carrier returns the order; the lines are refunded in full, and the fulfillment fee only where the method refunds it on return to sender.

**Clause 5 - Freight redelivery at the redelivery fee (retired).** Formerly: a freight order whose included attempts failed may be redelivered for the method's redelivery fee. This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for rebooking a freight redelivery.

**Clause 6 - Signature deliveries.** Orders whose method requires a signature are never left unattended.

### Clauses in force at a glance

| Situation | Outcome under the clauses in force |
|---|---|
| Order placed after the method's cutoff time | The promise is counted from the next day |
| Delay caused by the customer's absence or a changed address | Never late |
| Included delivery attempts all failed | The carrier returns the order; lines refunded in full; fulfillment fee refunded only where the method provides for it |
| Method requires a signature | Never left unattended |

### Example (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Standard Ship-to-Home order fails every included delivery attempt and comes back to Tailwise. Its lines are refunded in full; its fulfillment fee is refunded only where the method's terms provide for a fee refund on return to sender.
